name: ARCANE
blurb: MAGIC MEASURED AS A FIELD: STRENGTH, TOLERANCE AN' FALLOFF WIT DISTANCE. FAILED LINES STAY ON RECORD!

arc_leyline.name: LEYLINE CARTOGRAPHY
arc_leyline.desc: A SURVEY OF DA ARCANE CURRENT IN DA CRUST, RUN WIT THREE INSTRUMENTS: A DIP NEEDLE DAT READS DA VERTICAL COMPONENT, BRINE PROBES SUNK AT INTERVALS TA LOG CONDUCTIVITY AGAINST DEPTH, AN' A COMPASS WHOSE DEVIATION IZ REPEATABLE AN' THEREFORE USABLE AS A BEARIN'. WALKED ON A GRID, DA THREE YIELD A LINE'S COURSE, ITS DEPTH, AN' ITS THROUGHPUT TA WITHIN A FEW PERCENT. EVERY WORKIN' RECORDED AFTERWARDS IZ SPECIFIED AS A DISTANCE AN' A BEARIN' FROM A SURVEYED LINE, BECAUSE NO MEASUREMENT OF A WORKIN' MEANS ANYTHIN' WITHOUT ONE!

arc_tradeoff.name: DA CENTRAL TRADEOFF
arc_tradeoff.desc: DA CENTRAL RESULT OF DA SURVEY, MEASURED OVER SOME FOUR HUNDRED REPETITIONS AT GRADED DISTANCES. AMBIENT FIELD FALLS ROUGHLY AS DA INVERSE SQUARE OF DA DISTANCE FROM A LINE, WHILE DA COEFFICIENT OF VARIATION OF A WORKIN''S RADIUS, DURATION AN' TARGET RISES WIT PROXIMITY: ON DA LINE ITSELF DA SAME RITE DELIVERS BETWEEN A THIRD AN' FOUR TIMES ITS NOMINAL OUTPUT, AN' AT TWO HUNDRED PACES IT REPEATS TA WITHIN THREE PERCENT OF A MUCH SMALLER FIGURE. DERE IZ NO DISTANCE AT WHICH BOTH IZ FAVOURABLE. BATTLEMAGES WORK DA NEAR FIELD AN' HOSPITALS DA FAR, AN' DA CHOICE IZ A CHOICE OF VARIANCE!

arc_distillation.name: ARCANE ESSENCE DISTILLATION
arc_distillation.desc: RUNOFF DRAWN FROM WITHIN TEN PACES OF A LINE IZ CONCENTRATED BY REPEATED FREEZIN' AN' DECANTIN', SOME FORTY CYCLES, EACH DISCARDIN' DA FRACTION DAT SOLIDIFIES. DA SEALED VIAL DAT RESULTS READS AS A POINT SOURCE STRONG ENOUGH TA PULL A COMPASS OFF TRUE AT FOUR METRES, HOLDS ITS CHARGE WIT A LEAK RATE UNDER ONE PERCENT A MONTH, AN' CAN BE METERED OUT BY LOUDNESS, SO AN EXPENDITURE CAN BE STATED IN MILLILITRES INSTEAD OF IN INTENTION. CHARGE DENSITY IZ PROPORTIONAL TA DA YIELD OF DA SOURCE LINE, AN' NO PROCESS IZ KNOWN DAT RAISES IT FURTHER!

arc_dead_flats.name: DA DEAD-MAGIC FLATS
arc_dead_flats.desc: A BASIN WHERE DA AMBIENT FIELD READS BELOW DA THRESHOLD OF DA DIP NEEDLE ACROSS SOME SIXTY SQUARE KILOMETRES, WIT NO LINE WITHIN A DAY'S WALK. IN IT DA RADIUS, DURATION AN' TARGET OF A WORKIN' IZ LINEAR IN DA MANA SPENT, WIT RESIDUALS UNDER TWO PERCENT ACROSS DA WHOLE RANGE, AN' DA SAME RITE REPEATS TA WITHIN A HAND'S BREADTH ON CONSECUTIVE DAYS. IT IZ DA REFERENCE FRAME: A SPELL IZ CALIBRATED HERE, ITS COEFFICIENTS IZ RECORDED HERE, AN' ITS BEHAVIOUR ANYWHERE ELSE IZ QUOTED AS A DEPARTURE FROM DA FIGURES TAKEN IN DA FLATS!

arc_names_power.name: NAMES IZ POWER
arc_names_power.desc: A TRUE NAME BINDS BY ORTHOGRAPHY. DA INCANTATION HAB TA BE UTTERED AS ONE FUSED TOKEN: ANY SEAM, ANY PAUSE LONGER DEN ABOUT EIGHTY MILLISECONDS, ANY INSERTED VOWEL OPENS A FAULT AT WHICH DA BINDIN' FAILS. PRONUNCIATION IZ DA PARSER, AN' A MALFORMED TOKEN DOES NO FAIL QUIETLY, SINCE DA CHANNEL IZ ALREADY OPEN WHEN DA FAULT IZ DETECTED AN' DA WORKIN' DISCHARGES BACK ALONG IT INTO DA SPEAKER. RECORDED FAILURE MODES IZ GRADED BY WHERE IN DA TOKEN DA SEAM FALLS, AN' DA RECOIL IZ MEASURED IN DA SAME UNITS AS DA INTENDED OUTPUT!

arc_fidelity.name: RITUAL FIDELITY
arc_fidelity.desc: A CLASS OF WORKINGS DAT DRAW NO MEASURABLE MANA AT ALL, PAYIN' IN PREPARATION TIME INSTEAD. DA DIAGRAM, DA WORDIN' AN' DA HOUR MUST BE REPRODUCED INSIDE TOLERANCE: A SIGIL DISPLACED BY MORE DEN ABOUT A FINGER'S WIDTH, OR AN HOUR MISSED BY MORE DEN A QUARTER, VOIDS DA WORKIN' ENTIRELY. DERE IZ NO PARTIAL OUTPUT AN' NO PROPORTIONAL DEGRADATION, SO DA YIELD CURVE AGAINST FIDELITY IZ A STEP. DURATION SCALES WIT DA TIME SPENT LAYIN' DA DIAGRAM, SO DA METHOD IZ USABLE IN DA DEAD FLATS AN' UNUSABLE UNDER PRESSURE!

arc_charge.name: ETHEREAL CHARGE-HOLDIN'
arc_charge.desc: AETHER SOLIDIFIED UNDER PRESSURE HOLDS A STORED CHARGE WIT A MEASURED HALF-LIFE OF FOUR TA SEVEN MONTHS, AGAINST HOURS FOR WOOD AN' MINUTES FOR WORKED METAL, WHICH BLEED THROUGH DEY OWN CONDUCTIVITY. DA SHARD IZ INERT UNTIL A CHANNEL IZ OPENED TA IT AN' TAKES CHARGE AT A RATE LIMITED BY DA CROSS-SECTION OF DA CONTACT. IT IZ DA STANDARD RESERVOIR STAGE: ANYTHIN' INTENDED TA WORK AWAY FROM A LINE IZ SPECIFIED BY DA CAPACITY OF DA SHARD IT CARRIES AN' DA DRAW ITS CHANNEL PERMITS!

arc_dream_prep.name: DREAM PREPARATION
arc_dream_prep.desc: SPELL SELECTION PERFORMED DURIN' SLEEP DRAWS ON DA FIELD OF DA DREAMIN' INSTEAD OF DA LOCAL LINE, SO DA PREPARATION COSTS NOTHIN' AT DA SITE AN' WORKS IN DA FLATS. DA SET CHOSEN IZ HELD LOADED ON WAKIN'. SELECTION FIDELITY IZ DA DEFECT: ACROSS LOGGED TRIALS, BETWEEN A THIRD AN' A HALF OF DA INTENDED SET IZ PRESENT ON WAKIN', DA REMAINDER REPLACED BY WORKINGS DA SLEEPER KNOWS BUT DID NO CHOOSE, AN' DERE IZ NO WAY TA INSPECT DA LOADED SET BEFORE IT IZ CAST!

arc_sympathetic.name: SYMPATHETIC COUPLIN'
arc_sympathetic.desc: A FOCUS DAT SHARES MATERIAL OR HISTORY WIT A TARGET COUPLES TA IT, SO DA WORKIN' IZ ADDRESSED TA DA FOCUS AN' RESOLVES ON DA TARGET WIT NO MEASURED DEPENDENCE ON SEPARATION OUT TA DA LIMIT OF DA SURVEY. COUPLIN' STRENGTH SCALES WIT DA SPECIFICITY OF DA LINK AN' IZ ROUGHLY LOGARITHMIC IN IT: A GARMENT GIVES A WEAK COUPLIN', A PERSONAL NAME A STRONGER ONE, HAIR AN' BLOOD DA STRONGEST RECORDED. DA COUPLIN' IZ SYMMETRIC, AN' NOTHIN' IN DA METHOD PREVENTS DA FAR END FROM BEING DA ONE DAT ADDRESSES DA FOCUS!

arc_geomancy_porphyrin.name: PORPHYRIN AN' DA OIL THEORY
arc_geomancy_porphyrin.desc: EVERY CRUDE OIL RESERVOIR CARRIES BOUND PETRODEMONIC ENTITIES, AN' DA PORPHYRINS ALREADY PRESENT IN DA CRUDE THREAD A CHANNEL BETWEEN RESERVOIR, BLOOD OFFERIN' AN' LEYLINE. THROUGHPUT EXCEEDS A SURVEYED LINE BY TWO ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE AN' DOES NO DECLINE WIT DRAW, SINCE DA RESERVOIR IZ NO DA SOURCE. DA CHANNEL CONDUCTS IN BOTH DIRECTIONS AN' HAB NO METERIN' STAGE, SO DA STANDARD INSTALLATION IZ A LENGTH OF LINE WIT A BREAK IN IT, AN' DA RECORDED INCIDENTS IZ ALL INCIDENTS OF REVERSE FLOW!

arc_convokation.name: CONVOKATION OF DA SEVENTY-TWO
arc_convokation.desc: A SEALED RING, SEVENTY-TWO AUTHENTICATED SEALS LAID IN DA PRESCRIBED ORDER AN' AN UNBROKEN RECITATION BIND AN' COMMAND DA WHOLE HIERARCHY IN ONE WORKIN'. RUNTIME IZ BETWEEN THREE AN' NINE DAYS DEPENDIN' ON DA ORDER CHOSEN, DA RECITATION MAY NO BE INTERRUPTED FOR LONGER DEN IT TAKES TA BREATHE, AN' RELIEF OPERATORS NO CAN BE SUBSTITUTED MID-RITE BECAUSE DA BINDIN' IZ KEYED TA ONE VOICE. DA RECORDED FAILURES IZ FAILURES OF DA OPERATOR: EXHAUSTION, A SEAL LAID OUT OF SEQUENCE, A NAME GIVEN IN DA WRONG CASE!

arc_metamagic.name: METAMAGIC SUBLIMATION
arc_metamagic.desc: EVERY PHYSICAL COMPONENT OF A RITE, CHALK, SPOKEN WORD, FOCUS AN' HOUR, IZ REPLACED BY AN IMAGINED EQUIVALENT HELD IN WORKIN' MEMORY FOR DA DURATION. WIT NO PHYSICAL SUBSTRATE DA TOLERANCES DAT GOVERN EVERY LOWER METHOD DO NO APPLY: DA DIAGRAM NO CAN BE DISPLACED BECAUSE IT IZ NO ANYWHERE, AN' OUTPUT STOPS TRACKIN' DISTANCE FROM A LINE. WHAT IT TRACKS INSTEAD IZ DA OPERATOR, AN' DA FAILURE MODES RECORDED IZ ALL OF DEM FAILURE MODES OF DA OPERATOR!

arc_crystal_healing.name: CRYSTAL HEALIN'
arc_crystal_healing.desc: COLOURED QUARTZ LAID ON DA BODY AT POINTS FIXED BY TRADITION, ON A STATED MECHANISM BY WHICH DA LATTICE FOCUSES AMBIENT FIELD INTO TISSUE. INSTRUMENTED ON A STRONG LINE, DA STONES DO CONCENTRATE A FIELD OF A FEW PERCENT ABOVE AMBIENT AT DA SURFACE, FALLIN' BELOW DA DETECTION THRESHOLD AT TWO CENTIMETRES OF DEPTH. OFF A LINE, AMBIENT IZ UNDER THRESHOLD TA BEGIN WIT AN' DA CONCENTRATION IZ OF NOTHIN'. PAIRED TRIALS AGAINST INERT GLASS OF DA SAME COLOUR AN' WEIGHT RETURN DA SAME REPORTED RELIEF IN BOTH ARMS!

arc_talking_board.name: DA TALKIN' BOARD
arc_talking_board.desc: A PLANCHETTE ON A LOW-FRICTION BOARD UNDER DA FINGERS OF SEVERAL SITTERS SPELLS OUT LETTERS. BLINDFOLDIN' DA SITTERS, OR ROTATIN' DA BOARD WITHOUT TELLIN' DEM, COLLAPSES DA OUTPUT INTO NONSENSE, WHICH PLACES DA DRIVE IN DA IDEOMOTOR EFFECT: UNCONSCIOUS MUSCULAR OUTPUT SUMMED ACROSS HANDS, WIT DA SITTER WHO KNOWS DA ANSWER SUPPLYIN' IT. ON A STRONG LINE A RESIDUE OF SESSIONS PRODUCES OUTPUT DAT SURVIVES DA BLINDFOLD, AT A RATE A LIL' ABOVE WHAT DA LETTER FREQUENCIES ALONE WOULD GIVE. FROM INSIDE DA SESSION DA TWO CASES IZ INDISTINGUISHABLE, AN' NO SITTER HAB EVER CALLED WHICH ONE DEY WAZ IN!

arc_spirit_photography.name: SPIRIT PHOTOGRAPHY
arc_spirit_photography.desc: AN ETHEREAL SHARD WIRED ACROSS DA PLATE IZ MEANT TA SENSITISE DA EMULSION TA DA FIELD. FRAME-BY-FRAME EXAMINATION OF DA EXPOSURES ACCOUNTS FOR DA FEATURES BY DOUBLE EXPOSURE, LENS FLARE, EMULSION DEFECTS AN' SHUTTER BOUNCE, IN DAT ORDER OF FREQUENCY; DA FACES IZ SUPPLIED BY DA VIEWER, AN' CONTROL PLATES SHOT WIT DA SHARD REMOVED PRODUCE DEM AT DA SAME RATE. WHERE DA SHARD DOES CONTRIBUTE, DA DIFFERENCE BETWEEN EXPOSED AN' CONTROL PLATES STAYS UNDER DA GRAIN NOISE OF DA EMULSION, SO NO AMOUNT OF PRINTIN' WILL LIFT IT OUT!

arc_seventytwo_seals.name: DA SEVENTY-TWO SEALS
arc_seventytwo_seals.desc: EACH OF DA SEVENTY-TWO NAMES HAB TA BE MATCHED TA ITS AUTHENTICATED SEAL BEFORE DA RING CAN BE CLOSED. DA WORK IZ RECOVERY AN' VERIFICATION: SEALS IZ DUG OUT OF RUINS OR TRANSCRIBED FROM DREAM, COLLATED AGAINST DA KNOWN FORGERIES, AN' CHECKED FOR DA TWO FEATURES DA FORGERIES REPRODUCE WRONGLY, DA STROKE ORDER AN' DA CLOSURE OF DA OUTER BAND. A SINGLE UNVERIFIED SEAL VOIDS DA ENTIRE CONVOCATION AT DA POINT IT IZ REACHED, WIT DA RING ALREADY OPEN, SO VERIFICATION IZ DONE BEFORE DA RING IZ DRAWN AN' NEVER DURIN'!

arc_imagination_discipline.name: DA DISCIPLINE OF PURE IMAGINATION
arc_imagination_discipline.desc: DA RITE MUST BE HELD WHOLE IN DA MIND, WITHOUT DRIFT, FOR AS LONG AS IT TAKES TA RUN. TRAININ' IZ MEASURED AS UNBROKEN HOLD TIME UNDER DISTRACTION, STARTIN' AT SECONDS AN' REACHIN' HOURS OVER YEARS, WIT AN EXAMINATION DAT ADDS NOISE, COLD AN' INTERRUPTION. DA FAILURE MODE IZ NO A FAILED WORKIN': DA IMAGINED SUBSTRATE IZ WHAT DA OPERATOR IZ STANDIN' ON WHILE DA RITE RUNS, AN' DA RECORDED CASES OF DRIFT PAST A CERTAIN DEPTH END WIT AN OPERATOR WHO IZ STILL BREATHIN' AN' DOES NO COME BACK!
